title: Presidents Salary Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Presidents Salary Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
PRESIDENT'S SALARY, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
2002
ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the President's Salary, Allowances and
Privileges Act, 1975)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
27th February, 2002]
F. No.2(I)/2002-Pub., dated
27-2-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President hereby
published for general information:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called
the President's Salary, Allowances and Privileges (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from the first day of May, 2001.

sections.shortTitle: Presidents Salary Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Act LVIII of 1975

ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
PRESIDENT'S SALARY, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
2002
ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the President's Salary, Allowances and
Privileges Act, 1975)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
27th February, 2002]
F. No.2(I)/2002-Pub., dated
27-2-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President hereby
published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 3, Act LVIII of 1975.---In the President's
Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975, hereinafter referred to as the
said Act, in section 3, for the word "twenty-three" the word
"fifty-seven" shall be substituted.
